'''House Barong''' was one of the [[Tapani Noble Houses|noble houses]] of the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] during the [[Old Sith Wars|period]] that included the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

During the Great Sith War period, [[High Lord|High Lady]] [[Brezwalt III]] of [[House Mecetti]] [[Assassinations in the Nyssa system|ordered]] her [[Mecrosa Order]] [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassins]] to dispose of the leader of House Barong and four other rival houses. Their leader was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] and Barong was absorbed into House Mecetti.

House Barong was not around during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].
